Table 2-3  Accessories

| Item                                              | Description                                                                                                                                                   | Part number   |
|---------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------|
| 1 x 550-sheet paper feeder                        | Optional 550-sheet paper feeder (The M501 printer supports one 1 x 550-sheet paper feeder. All other models support up to three 1 x 550-sheet paper feeders.) | F2A72A        |
| Printer stand and cabinet                         | Optional stand with storage cabinet to support the printer (Recommended when using multiple optional paper feeders.)                                          | F2A73A        |
| 500 GB HP Secure High-Performance Hard Disk Drive | Accessory hard drive (M506/E50045/M507/ E50145/M527/E52545/M528/E52645 only)                                                                                  | B5L29A        |
| 320 GB HP Secure High-Performance Hard Disk Drive | Standard hard drive (M527/E52545 only)                                                                                                                        | 5851-6712     |
